topic: Steph Curry successfully making an incredible tunnel shot that other NBA players fail at.

hook.first_words: This is proof that Steph Curry was actually not human.
hook.first_frame: Steph Curry holding a basketball in the tunnel behind the court, surrounded by fans and security.

script: This is proof that Steph Curry was actually not human. You see, many NBA players have tried to take a full court shot, but they usually miss. One time, Jarrett Jack attempted a full court shot, but it went straight into the fans. Then Luka Doncic tried this challenge too, but the ball bounced off the top of the backboard. The same thing happened here. Kyle Kuzma tried a full court shot, but it didn't go in. Meanwhile, Steph Curry is built different. When he did the same challenge, he easily got the bucket.

montage of failures leading to the final success
